note: Step 0b (docs/internet_research_protocol.md §5a), revision 2026-10-30.2, fixed before any Step-0b call. Every call is made, in this order, whatever the earlier answers; P1b in a later message than every other call; a generic error is retried once after P1b, in a later message, as <label>_r. Every result is saved with tools/save_connector_text.py --raw --label <label> --record saves_0b.jsonl under the file named here (retries raw_<label>_r_<id>.txt, late results raw_<label>_late_<id>.txt); a call without a result is recorded with --no-result. Queries are copied verbatim from the Step-0 calls (Q_DIS, Q_KAYA, Q_MULHC) or from the committed pre-registration of 2026-10-30 (Q_2203, Q_2201, Q_2101). The saved files are git-ignored; saves_0b.jsonl, audit_0b.json and result_0b.json hold no delivered text except one-line refusals.
